opinions.title: The Gravel Bike Everyone Is Sleeping On… WINSPACE G5
opinions.configuration: Size L complete bike with SRAM Rival XPLR 1×13, Gryper 2 D45 wheels and 40 mm Michelin Power tires; 8.88 kg with pedals and the included frame bag.
opinions.summary: Calls it a phenomenal value aero gravel bike for about US$5,200–5,400: 58 mm front and 53 mm rear clearance, internal storage, UDH, T47 and a road-capable look. One niggle: the supplied caliper spacing was set for 140 mm while a 160 mm rotor was fitted, with no note explaining it.
opinions.caveat: A walk-around before any reported riding; the creator shares a discount code.

opinions.title: Winspace G5 Unboxing and Quality Check 😢
opinions.configuration: New size L frameset in Alpine White.
opinions.summary: The owner found disappointing paint-finish defects right out of the box, especially around the brake mounts, threaded inserts and down-tube storage hatch, and opened a claim with the seller and Winspace.
opinions.caveat: Claim outcome not recorded; one frame.
